description: This file defines a set of React components for a custom Select UI element, wrapping Radix UI primitives and adding styling and structure.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main component for the select dropdown, rendering Radix UI Root.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping select items, rendering Radix UI Group.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Component displaying the selected value, rendering Radix UI Value.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button that opens the dropdown, rendering Radix UI Trigger with custom styling.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content, rendering Radix UI Content with custom animations and positioning.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Component for labeling sections within the select dropdown.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component for individual selectable items, rendering Radix UI Item with custom styling.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for visual separation between items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up in the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down in the dropdown list.
